title: Conical Scanner Validation: AMSR2 (eval claims fixture)

excerpts.text: Evaluation fixture text, not a reviewed source claim: AMSR2's lines of sight lie on a cone 47.564 degrees from geodetic nadir, scanning about 0.498 degrees in azimuth with a 75.332-degree product-sector half width and a 1.0-degree along-track field of view, in the inertial velocity frame with nadir referenced to the geodetic nadir and no illumination gating.
